final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT c.gender AS g, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS n FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS a FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.g AS g, s1.n AS n, s1.n - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.n > s2.a) SELECT AVG(n), AVG(d) FROM s3
